### Added

- *(agent-platform)* Port to kagent api.kagent.dev/v1alpha3 Agents and Sessions in [#2727](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2727) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)

### Changed

- Align files according to platform standards in [#2814](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2814) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot])

### Fixed

- *(plans)* The Hive team filter narrows Now, History and Plans in [#2806](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2806) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(gs)* Drop the Alerts link from the cluster details page's default links in [#2816](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2816) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(plans)* Hive tabs and Plans page wait out a paused retry in [#2817](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2817) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(agent-platform)* Offer the pull request only for deleting an agent applied from git in [#2818](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2818) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(gs)* Scope the Deployments page's Mimir queries by cluster, retry once in [#2825](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2825) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(gs)* Keep the router state when the installation scope writes the URL in [#2821](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2821) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Normalise an attachment's base64 without a regex in [#2824](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2824) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(build)* Define the tsc heap size once, in scripts/tsc.sh in [#2826](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2826) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
